info.brief: A chainable wrapper around a GUI node. `new` wraps a node or looks one up by id, and
info.description:
A chainable wrapper around a GUI node. `new` wraps a node or looks one up by id, and
each method calls the `gui.*` function of the same name with the wrapped node first:
setters return the wrapper, so calls chain, and getters return what the engine does.

parameters.name: node
parameters.doc: The node, or the id `gui.get_node` looks it up by.

functions.description: Animates one property with `gui.animate`.

parameters.doc: An easing constant, or a vector of easing samples.

functions.name: animate
functions.brief: Animates several properties with `gui.animate`, each to the value at the same index
functions.description:
Animates several properties with `gui.animate`, each to the value at the same index
of `to`, all with the same easing, duration, delay and playback.

parameters.name: to
parameters.doc: The value to animate each property to, by index.

parameters.name: easing
parameters.doc: An easing constant, or a vector of easing samples.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.doc: The delay in seconds before the animations start. Defaults to `0`.

parameters.name: complete_function
parameters.doc: Called once the first property's animation completes.

functions.description: Cancels the node's animations with `gui.cancel_animations`.

omitted, every animation of the node is canceled.

functions.description: Cancels the node's animations, the same as `cancel_animations`.
